# tests/test_max_subarray_sum.py

import pytest

from your_module import max_subarray_sum  # replace "your_module" with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "arr, expected",
    [
        ([1, 2, 3, 4], 10),
        ([-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4], 6),
        ([5, -2, 3, 4], 10),
        ([-2, -3, 4, -1, -2, 1, 5, -3], 7),
        ([-10, 2, 3, -2, 5, -15], 8),
    ],
)
def test_max_subarray_sum_happy_path(arr, expected):
    assert max_subarray_sum(arr) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "arr, expected",
    [
        ([], 0),
        ([0], 0),
        ([7], 7),
        ([-7], -7),
        ([0, 0, 0], 0),
        ([-8, -3, -6, -2, -5, -4], -2),
        ([4, -1, -2, -3], 4),          # max subarray at beginning
        ([-3, -2, 4, -1, 2], 5),       # max subarray at end
        ([10**18, -1, 10**18], 2 * 10**18 - 1),
    ],
)
def test_max_subarray_sum_edge_cases(arr, expected):
    assert max_subarray_sum(arr) == expected


def test_max_subarray_sum_does_not_mutate_input():
    arr = [-2, 1, -3, 4, -1, 2, 1, -5, 4]
    original = arr.copy()

    assert max_subarray_sum(arr) == 6
    assert arr == original


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(123, id="non_list_integer"),
        pytest.param(object(), id="non_list_object"),
        pytest.param([1, "2", 3], id="mixed_int_and_string"),
        pytest.param([1, None, 3], id="contains_none"),
        pytest.param([1, {}, 3], id="contains_dict"),
    ],
)
def test_max_subarray_sum_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        max_subarray_sum(bad_input)
